description: Research-derived expression and emotion-gradient palette spanning valence and arousal quadrants.

expressions.label: Neutral
expressions.instruction: Show composed neutrality with level brows, relaxed jaw, closed mouth, forward eyes, and a natural still posture.

expressions.label: Happy
expressions.instruction: Show friendly happiness with a small genuine smile, soft eyes, relaxed brows, loose shoulders, and an open comfortable posture.

expressions.label: Sad
expressions.instruction: Show quiet sadness with downcast eyes, raised inner brows, a thin unhappy mouth, slumped shoulders, and an inward posture.

expressions.label: Angry
expressions.instruction: Show controlled anger with sharply knitted brows, a set jaw, hard direct eyes, squared shoulders, and a braced confrontational posture.

expressions.label: Surprised
expressions.instruction: Show genuine surprise with raised brows, widened eyes, a slightly open mouth, and a small instinctive lean backward.

expressions.label: Fearful
expressions.instruction: Show fear with wide tense eyes, raised drawn-together brows, parted lips, lifted shoulders, and a recoiling guarded posture.

expressions.label: Disgusted
expressions.instruction: Show disgust with a wrinkled nose, raised upper lip, narrowed eyes, furrowed brows, and the head and torso pulling away.

expressions.label: Embarrassed
expressions.instruction: Show embarrassment with a visible blush, sharply averted eyes, tense mouth, drawn-in shoulders, and a stiff self-conscious posture.

expressions.label: Confused
expressions.instruction: Show confusion with one brow raised, the other pinched, unfocused questioning eyes, a slight head tilt, and hesitant posture.

expressions.label: Smug
expressions.instruction: Show smug amusement with a one-sided smirk, half-lidded knowing eyes, slightly raised chin, and relaxed superior posture.

expressions.label: Joyful (Laughing)
expressions.instruction: Show peak joy with open genuine laughter, nearly closed eyes, raised brows, head tipped back, and loose animated shoulders.

expressions.label: Despair (Crying)
expressions.instruction: Show a grief breakdown with streaming tears, trembling mouth, painfully knitted brows, lowered head, and collapsed vulnerable posture.

expressions.label: Determined
expressions.instruction: Show focused determination with narrowed steady eyes, firm mouth, lowered brows, chin forward, squared shoulders, and grounded readiness.

expressions.label: Flirty
expressions.instruction: Show active charm with a slow knowing smile, half-lidded eyes, one slightly raised brow, a gentle head tilt, and loose inviting confidence.

expressions.label: Worried
expressions.instruction: Show sympathetic concern with furrowed brows, intent worried eyes, tightened mouth, lifted shoulders, and a slight urgent lean forward.

expressions.label: Thoughtful
expressions.instruction: Show contemplation with eyes focused slightly aside, gently pinched brows, relaxed closed mouth, tilted head, and a quiet considering posture.

expressions.label: Hurt
expressions.instruction: Show sudden pain with tightly pinched brows, a strained mouth, partly closed eyes, raised tense shoulders, and protective inward body language.

expressions.label: Bored
expressions.instruction: Show boredom with half-lidded unfocused eyes, flat brows, slack mouth, tilted head, and a low-energy slouched posture.

expressions.label: Tired
expressions.instruction: Show exhaustion with drooping eyelids, low relaxed brows, softly open mouth, head leaning to one side, and heavy sagging posture.

expressions.label: Triumphant
expressions.instruction: Show victory with a broad proud smile, bright direct eyes, raised chin, shoulders pulled back, and an expansive celebratory posture.

expressions.label: Relieved
expressions.instruction: Show relief with gently closed or softened eyes, a small grateful smile, released shoulders, and posture settling after a long exhale.

expressions.label: Suspicious
expressions.instruction: Show guarded suspicion with narrowed side-looking eyes, slightly furrowed brows, tight mouth, body angled away, and weight held back.

expressions.label: Nostalgic
expressions.instruction: Show bittersweet remembrance with a faint distant smile, softened unfocused eyes, gently raised inner brows, and quiet reflective posture.

expressions.label: Sinister
expressions.instruction: Show controlled menace with a small unsettling smile, cold fixed eyes, lowered brows, still shoulders, and deliberate predatory composure.
